entry.content: Atlas 0.1.10: hold a finger on the map to open what is there (a shop, a building, a saved place), or to mark a bare point, with Route to, Save and, while a route is up, Add stop; the mark on a selected place is a black ring with a dot; a search button on the turn card finds fuel, food or anything else during a trip, and Add stop puts it on the way; a trip sent back to its plan offers Resume in place of Start; a Dark mode switch in Settings, Interface (white on black; the map keeps its own colors)

entry.title: Messaging 1.35.35
entry.content: Messaging 1.35.35: the Signal "Linked devices" screen opens again; it closed the moment it was opened. New in Settings, under Display: Silence unknown senders. With it on, a text from a number that is not in your contacts raises no notification and waits under Unknown

entry.title: Messaging 1.35.34
entry.content: Messaging 1.35.34: a picture can be copied in one chat and pasted into another. Hold a picture in a text or Signal chat and choose Copy picture, then hold the message box of any chat and choose Paste. An empty message box now offers Paste too, for words as well as pictures
